from pathlib import Path
import sys,json,hashlib,gzip,datetime

def sha(b):return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
def main():
 assert len(sys.argv)==3,'actual record and NEW EMPTY /tmp archive directory required'
 rp=Path(sys.argv[1]);dest=Path(sys.argv[2]);assert dest.is_absolute() and str(dest).startswith('/tmp/') and not dest.exists();dest.mkdir()
 r=json.loads(rp.read_text());assert r['category'] in {'daren-retirement-console-menu','daren-retirement-save-rewards','daren-retirement-storage-refusal','daren-retirement-ordinary-storage','daren-retirement-browser-host'};rows=[]
 def save(p,relative,expected=None):
  p=Path(p);assert p.is_file() and not p.is_symlink();b=p.read_bytes()
  if expected is not None:assert len(b)==expected['bytes'] and sha(b)==expected['sha256']
  stored=dest/(relative+'.gz');assert not stored.exists();stored.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);z=gzip.compress(b,mtime=0);stored.write_bytes(z);assert gzip.decompress(stored.read_bytes())==b
  rows.append(dict(rawPath=str(p),storedPath=relative+'.gz',bytes=len(b),sha256=sha(b),storedBytes=len(z),storedSha256=sha(z),compression='gzip mtime0'))
 save(rp,'native/record.json');save(r['stdoutPath'],'native/stdout.log');save(r['firstLaunchSentinel'],'native/first-launch-sentinel.json')
 if Path(r['processRecord']).is_file():save(r['processRecord'],'native/process.json')
 for p in r['resultFiles']:
  path=Path(p['path']);matches=[(i,Path(d)) for i,d in enumerate(r['resultDirectories']) if path.is_relative_to(Path(d))];assert len(matches)==1;i,base=matches[0];save(path,'runner/'+str(i)+'/'+str(path.relative_to(base)),p)
 for p in r['fixtureArtifactFiles']:
  path=Path(p['path']);matches=[Path(d) for d in r['newRetainedArtifactDirectories'] if path.is_relative_to(Path(d))];assert len(matches)==1;base=matches[0];assert base.parent==Path('/tmp') and base.name.startswith('boe-daren-retirement-artifacts-');save(path,'artifacts/'+base.name+'/'+str(path.relative_to(base)),p)
 packet=dict(kind='EXACT_FIRST_CONSUMER_RED_OWNER_RAW_ARCHIVE_NOT_INDEPENDENT_ACCEPTANCE',utc=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),actualSource=r['actualSource'],compiledSource=r['compiledSource'],productSource=r['productSource'],nativeExit=r['nativeExit'],recordPath=str(rp),recordSha256=sha(rp.read_bytes()),files=rows,helperText=Path(__file__).read_text(),scope='Exact FIRST native/runner raw and support. No producer/consumer launch, fixture installation/transformation or owned cleanup is performed by this archiver. Parent release governs any repository persistence.')
 (dest/'archive.json').write_text(json.dumps(packet,indent=2)+'\n');print('EXACT_FIRST_CONSUMER_RED_OWNER_ARCHIVE',dest,'rawchains',len(rows),'nativeExit',r['nativeExit'])
if __name__=='__main__':main()
